summary: Hyatt Hotels Corp filed an 8-K announcing its Board authorized an additional $1.0 billion share repurchase program for its Class A and Class B common stock. Repurchases may occur via open market, private transactions, Rule 10b5-1 plans, or accelerated share repurchase transactions at the company's discretion, subject to market conditions and applicable law. The authorization does not obligate Hyatt to repurchase any specific amount and may be suspended or discontinued at any time. Investors should watch the pace of buyback execution and potential impact on earnings per share.
